content:
maya: quick idea — want to surface routing & quota hints directly in the quick-save flow for per-route / per-model views. show estimated token burn and a fallback suggestion if we expect quota spikes. thoughts?

alex: love it. can we make it non-blocking? tooltip + cheap fallback button rather than forcing a change. :+1:

raj: how do we compute the "predicted" quota usage? is this a simple multiply of recent avg tokens * expected hits or something ML-backed?

linda: from PM side would prefer conservative estimates, and show a 3-tier confidence (low/med/high) not a precise number — avoids legal/regret. also flag for dedicated customers that they can opt out.

zane: technical note — telemetry window matters. we need per-route QPS + token distribution per model + time-of-day. simplest: exponential moving average over last 24h weighted by hour-of-day. fallback logic: if projected burn > threshold -> suggest quantized/cheaper model or cached-preview.

maya: agreed on confidence bands. UX sketch: a small bar in the quick-save modal: [cost estimate] [confidence dot] [fallback suggestion link]. clicking fallback shows list of compatible variants.

alex: small API thought — current save endpoint is dumb: `POST /console/saves` with full blob. propose adding `preview=true` and `cost_hint=true` query params and a new lightweight response shape. eg:
```
POST /console/saves?preview=true&cost_hint=true
{
  route_id: "r_123",
  view: { filters: [...], models: [...] }
}
```
Response: `status: ok, cost_estimate: { tokens: 1234, dollars: "0.12", confidence: "med" }, suggested_variants: ["gptx-8q", "gptx-4q"]`

raj: +1 on preview flags. one ask: please include telemetry sample ids so we can link back to the exact telemetry slice in case of regressions. e.g., `sample_bucket: "2026-03-20-utc-14"`.

linda: curious about rollout UX — we should gate this behind a staged rollout: beta to devex, then to 10% of orgs, and enterprise-off by default. need opt-out flag in org settings.

zane: backend work: two parts — (1) aggregator service returns cost_estimate & confidence from telemetry and recent prediction model, (2) feature flag + ui plumbing. aggregator needs to be fast (<50ms) to keep modal snappy. caching per-route-view key mandatory.

maya: latency concern noted. if aggregator misses cache, return quick conservative estimate and show spinner then replace with final. UX should avoid blocking save creation.

alex: small UX ask — show a one-line rationale when suggesting cheaper variant: e.g., "X% cheaper for similar latency based on 90th %ile." avoids surprise.

raj: telemetry bits — will add a debug endpoint that returns the raw metrics used for the estimate when `?debug=true` and only for internal users. helps SRE/ML debug.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feat/quicksave-cost-hints -> staging (sha: a1b2c3). scheduled 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.

linda: timeline check — can we get a minimal MVP (preview + tooltip + opt-out) in two sprints? if yes, we can include in next release notes.

maya: aiming for MVP in 2 sprints. will write PRD + mockups today. will post a brief follow-up with acceptance criteria: non-blocking, <100ms cached response, fallback list includes model compatibility checks, org opt-out.

alex: will help with front-end hooks. can we reuse existing save modal code and add a `costHint` slot?

zane: yes, add `costHint` slot to modal component. backend endpoint: `/internal/estimates/v1/quick_save` that returns a small payload. keep schema stable.

raj: note for future — could attach quality regression checks (small eval) for suggested cheaper variants so we don't recommend a variant that fails common prompts. file a follow-up ticket.

maya: thanks all. I'll drop the PRD here and @alex for frontend acceptance criteria.

alex: pinged. will review PRD later today.

linda: thanks team. excited. :party_parrot: 

maya: (internal) tagging SRE & ML for initial perf/runbook: @zane @raj.

zane: got it. I'll add SLOs and a canary for estimate accuracy.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: feat/quicksave-cost-hints @ 2026-03-25T02:05:12Z.

maya: will schedule a short demo in tomorrow's product sync.

alex: noted. short live demo pls. 10 min max.

linda: 10 min demo + opt-in list for devex.

maya: thanks — closing thread for now, will open follow-ups for PRD + tickets.
